briefdescription.para: Owned buffer, used to init Buffer if the provided stream doesn't happen to be a buffer itself.
Internal buffer for unflushed bytes (unless there is no stream to flush to, case in which these are "the bytes").

detaileddescription.para: The writer backpatches, so it is efficient to buffer.

briefdescription.para: FS - The file stream that Buffer flushes to.

detaileddescription.para: If FS is a raw_fd_stream, the writer will incrementally flush at subblock boundaries. Otherwise flushing will happen at the end of BitstreamWriter's lifetime.

briefdescription.para: FlushThreshold - this is the threshold (unit B) to flush to FS, if FS is a raw_fd_stream.
CurBit - Always between 0 and 31 inclusive, specifies the next bit to use.
CurValue - The current value. Only bits < CurBit are valid.
CurCodeSize - This is the declared size of code values used for the current block, in bits.
BlockInfoCurBID - When emitting a BLOCKINFO_BLOCK, this is the currently selected BLOCK ID.
CurAbbrevs - Abbrevs installed at in this block.
BlockScope - This tracks the current blocks that we have entered.
If the related file stream is a raw_fd_stream, flush the buffer if its size is above a threshold.

detaileddescription.para: If OnClosing is true, flushing happens regardless of thresholds.

briefdescription.para: EmitAbbreviatedLiteral - Emit a literal value according to its abbrev record.

detaileddescription.para: This is a no-op, since the abbrev specifies the literal to use.

briefdescription.para: EmitAbbreviatedField - Emit a single scalar field value with the specified encoding.

briefdescription.para: EmitRecordWithAbbrevImpl - This is the core implementation of the record emission code.

detaileddescription.para: If BlobData is non-null, then it specifies an array of data that should be emitted as part of the Blob or Array operand that is known to exist at the end of the record. If Code is specified, then it is the record code to emit before the Vals, which must not contain the code.

briefdescription.para: SwitchToBlockID - If we aren't already talking about the specified block ID, emit a BLOCKINFO_CODE_SETBID record.
Create a BitstreamWriter over a raw_ostream OutStream.

detaileddescription.para: If OutStream is a raw_svector_ostream, the BitstreamWriter will write directly to the latter's buffer. In all other cases, the BitstreamWriter will use an internal buffer and flush at the end of its lifetime.

In addition, if is a raw_fd_stream supporting seek, tell, and read (besides write), the BitstreamWriter will also flush incrementally, when a subblock is finished, and if the FlushThreshold is passed.

briefdescription.para: Convenience constructor for users that start with a vector - avoids needing to wrap it in a raw_svector_ostream.
For scenarios where the user wants to access a section of the stream to (for example) compute some checksum, disable flushing and remember the position in the internal buffer where that happened.

detaileddescription.para: Must be paired with a call to getMarkedBufferAndResumeFlushing.

briefdescription.para: resumes flushing, but does not flush, and returns the section in the internal buffer starting from the position marked with markAndBlockFlushing.

detaileddescription.para: The return should be processed before any additional calls to this object, because those may cause a flush and invalidate the return.

briefdescription.para: Retrieve the current position in the stream, in bits.
Retrieve the number of bits currently used to encode an abbrev ID.
Backpatch a byte in the output at the given bit offset with the specified value.

getBlockInfo - If there is block info for the specified ID, return it, otherwise return null.
Emit a blob, including flushing before and tail-padding.
EmitRecord - Emit the specified record to the stream, using an abbrev if we have one to compress the output.
EmitRecordWithAbbrev - Emit a record with the specified abbreviation.

detaileddescription.para: Unlike EmitRecord, the code for the record should be included in Vals as the first entry.

briefdescription.para: EmitRecordWithBlob - Emit the specified record to the stream, using an abbrev that includes a blob at the end.

detaileddescription.para: The blob data to emit is specified by the pointer and length specified at the end. In contrast to EmitRecord, this routine expects that the first entry in Vals is the code of the record.
